future_center_pairing_bound.scope: geometric necessary condition only; four fixed adjacent ancillas, fixed center anchor, and one external moving partner
assumptions: The center data anchor stays at its frozen home.
All four neighboring ancilla carriers remain alive at their frozen homes.
The external carrier is paired only with the center anchor in the matching CZ pulse.
Every nonpartner carrier must stay at least 10 um away at that pulse.
Only the external endpoint moves; no staging, spectator relocation, code motion or local illumination change is included.
future_center_pairing_bound.conclusion: No direct one-endpoint placement within finite 6 um of this fixed center satisfies all four 10 um nonpartner constraints.
why_current_prefix_passes: For a syndrome coupling the corresponding neighboring ancilla itself moves, vacating its direction.
The authored CSS encoder can choose the center data as the moving endpoint and use an eligible boundary data as its anchor.
future_options_require_actual_validation: Move the center to an explicit staging holder and preserve its identity.
Explicitly relocate the required spectator ancilla carriers before the pulse and restore them afterward.
Use another declared physical placement or motion protocol with full capture, trajectory, support and global pulse validation.
future_center_pairing_bound.boundary: This proves the restricted fixed-center direct-pairing limit, not infeasibility of transversal CNOT or all physical protocols. Future center-center inter-patch couplings require a new explicit validated staging/transport plan.
